test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Mary was cooking the meal.

options.text: The meal were being cooked by Mary.
The meal was already being cooked by Mary.
Mary was about to cook the meal.
The meal was being cooked by Mary.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The meal was being cooked by Mary.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The passive voice's object replaces the active voice's subject, and the subject of the Passive Voice also replaces the Active Voice's object.
 
• 'Ma
